A malformed data URI with extract_images enabled produces an ImageExtractionFailed warning

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"extract_images":true}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<p>Text<img src="data:BADMIME" alt="broken">end</p>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
    stdout.writeln(result.warnings);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
